title: Enterprise Products Partners L.P. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Enterprise Products Partners L.P. (EPD), a master limited partnership in the midstream energy sector headquartered in Houston, Texas, filed a Form 8-K on April 28, 2026, announcing its Q1 2026 financial and operating results via a press release and accompanying investor webcast. This is a standard corporate earnings disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Enterprise Products Partners L.P. filed Form 8-K on April 28, 2026, pursuant to Item 2.02 (Results of Operations and Financial Condition)
The company announced Q1 2026 financial and operating results for the three months ended March 31, 2026
A press release (Exhibit 99.1) was issued and an investor webcast conference call will be held
EPD common units trade on NYSE under ticker symbol EPD
The filing was signed by R. Daniel Boss, Executive Vice President and CFO of Enterprise Products Holdings LLC (General Partner)
